en.title: A more capable terminal, focused network tools
highlights: The TUI adapts to desktop and phone SSH terminals, with persistent node sorting and direct settings.
Profiles and shortcut rules have dedicated pages, and connection details distinguish original and sniffed domains.
Twelve network checks explain their limits; TUI can edit options and export the current report.
Recoverable installation errors remain visible with access to diagnostics.
en.known: Phone SSH devices, long-term memory behavior and the reported Windows code 68 incident remain unverified.
en.summary: Adaptive terminal controls, twelve network checks and visible update errors.

zh.title: 终端操作更灵活，网络工具更聚焦
highlights: TUI 适配桌面和手机 SSH 终端，支持持久节点排序与直接修改设置。
订阅和快捷规则拥有独立页面，连接详情区分原始域名与嗅探域名。
十二项网络检查说明测量边界，TUI 可直接编辑参数和导出当前报告。
可恢复的安装错误持续显示，并提供诊断入口。
zh.known: 手机 SSH 真机、长期内存表现及用户反馈的 Windows 代码 68 原因仍未完成验证。
zh.summary: 自适应终端、十二项网络检查，以及可见的更新错误。

en.title: Per-app exits on Android, a steadier Linux
highlights: Android per-app routing supports named rule groups, app search and chosen exits; app-specific exits need Android 10 or later.
Linux handles networks without IPv6, old autostart entries and rapid window resizing more reliably.
Node tests, updates and Geo downloads provide clearer errors and fallbacks.
Appearance settings and read-only pages stay usable during Claude protection.
en.known: Intermittent TLS failures and slow long-lived downloads were still being investigated.
en.summary: Refined app routing, updates and everyday connection management.

zh.title: 应用可指定出口，Linux 更稳
highlights: Android 应用分流支持命名规则组、搜索应用与指定出口；指定出口需 Android 10 及以上。
Linux 改进无 IPv6 网络启动、旧自启动入口与快速缩放窗口。
节点测速、更新与 Geo 下载的报错和回退更清晰。
Claude 保护期间，外观设置与只读页面继续可用。
zh.known: 当时仍在排查间歇性 TLS 失败与部分长连接下载慢速。
zh.summary: 应用分流、更新与日常连接管理进一步完善。

en.title: A refreshed interface
highlights: Refreshed interfaces on desktop, phone and tablet with a collapsible sidebar and consistent rule list.
Android per-app routing supports all, selected or excluded apps.
Subscription, Geo and client updates can try a separate direct route when the proxy is down.
Errors are shown by severity, with diagnostic export and issue shortcuts.

zh.title: 界面焕新
highlights: 桌面、手机与平板界面更新，侧栏可折叠，规则列表样式统一。
Android 应用分流支持全部应用、仅选中与排除选中。
订阅、Geo 与客户端更新在代理不可用时可尝试独立直连。
错误按影响程度展示，并提供导出诊断与新建 Issue 的入口。
